الإصدارات14 نوفمبر 2002

Release: vlc 0.4.6

This new release uses a52dec as the default decoder for AC3 sound for a better quality, fixes a hangup in the esd plugin, allows Windows NT/2000/XP users to read DVDs without administrator privileges and fixes a few segfaults. Have a look at the ChangeLog and go to the download page.
VLC 1.0.0-rc1, codename Goldeneye, is a test release of the 1.0.0 version of VLC. It introduces many new codecs, various playback core improvements (frame-by-frame, live-recording, instant pausing, etc...), interface improvements, new features and many bugfixes. We encourage people to test and report regressions that could have crept in this release.
المكتبات14 نوفمبر 2002

Release: libdvdcss 1.2.4

This release allows Windows NT/2000/XP users to watch DVDs with vlc 0.4.6 without administrator privileges. Check the libdvdcss page, and have a look at the Changelog.

Release: vlc 0.4.5

This new release brings enhancements to the BeOS and iPAQ familiar Linux ports, as well as a new RTP input. VLC is also compliant to general practice on how to embed A/52, DVD SPU and LPCM elementary streams in MPEG-2 TS. It can still read from VLS 0.3.x with the --vls-backwards-compat option. Visit the ChangeLog and the download page.

Release: vls 0.4.0

This new release adds IPv6 multicast support, language descriptors for audio and subpicture streams, and support for WinTV DVB-S. It also features an RTP output, runtime adding of programs and channels, start-up script, and is compliant to general practice on how to embed A/52, DVD SPU and LPCM elementary streams. This release requires VLC version 0.4.5 or later. Get it now from the download page!

VideoLAN29 مايو 2002

Tests at Centrale Paris

The VideoLAN Team is starting today a vast test campaign on the campus of the Ecole Centrale Paris. We are streaming 13 channels at the same time using multicast on the brand new network (Gigabit Ethernet backbone and 100 Mbit/s switches on the periphery from our partner Extreme Networks) of the VIA Centrale Réseaux association. The students are invited to visit www.videolan.org/tests/ for instructions.

VideoLAN14 مايو 2002

VideoLAN HOWTO

The VideoLAN HOWTO explains how to use the complete VideoLAN solution. It deals in particular with the different streaming methods (unicast, broadcast, multicast), the issue of IPv6, the use of channel tools, Video on Demand and the design of a complete solution. It has been written by Marc Ariberti and Alexis de Lattre.

Mirror Site

You probably experienced problems recently to access the VideoLAN Web, FTP and CVS servers. This was due to failure of the ISP. We have set up a mirror site with Web; FTP and read-only CVS. When the ISP of the main site is down, you will be automatically redirected to the mirror site.

VideoLAN6 أبريل 2002

VideoLAN Quickstart

The VideoLAN Quickstart describes how to start using VideoLAN quickly. Basic skills on Linux and Network should be enough to understand this Quickstart. It has been written by Bill Eldridge (bill@rfa.org) and Alexis de Lattre (alexis@videolan.org).

Release: vlc 0.3.0

This release fixes an amazing number of bugs and brings a lot of new features as well: Configuration file support, new input layer with IPv6 support and file format autodetection, new video output engine featuring speed increases up to 40%, VCD support under Mac OS X, multicast support and a new interface for Win32, network support under BeOS, satellite driver for WinTV Nova cards, video filters (deinterlacing, rotation, distort, image wall) and much more!
